title: Consolidate Hytale asset packs across saved worlds while preserving placed block identifiers
summary: A renamed unified Hytale 0.7.2 pack replaces a legacy world-local architecture pack and a globally installed Tall Wheat mod. Compare all legacy asset bytes, keep item/block IDs and paths, migrate saved-world plugin keys with verified rollback, and test isolated server loading before removing the old packages.
problem_class: merge duplicate mod identities without losing placed world assets
problem_description: The main map showed the obsolete BlackridgeMonasticDetails name, while Tall Wheat was a separate global mod. The user wanted a single correctly named Buildings and Furnishment mod, both legacy packages removed, and existing blocks kept compatible.
context: The architecture 1.1.0 packs have 80 resources that are already byte-identical to the vegetation 1.6.1 library. Tall Wheat adds seven resources and an empty JavaPlugin entry point. Six saved worlds reference Tall Wheat, three have world-local Blackridge packs, and one test world has both disabled.
constraints: Preserve old item/block IDs and asset paths
Do not write chunks while worlds are open
Remove old global mod only after migrating every known dependent world
Do not infer client rendering from a headless server boot

solution_versions.description: Build one Hytale pack under the desired manifest name, copy missing legacy assets without renaming any item/block IDs, migrate all affected world config keys with backup and rollback, and remove the retired packages only after verifying coverage.
changes: Retain 80 byte-identical Blackridge resources and 188 byte-identical 1.6.1 QA resources
Copy seven original Tall Wheat resource files into the pack; omit only its empty plugin class
Rename manifest to Zytale Buildings and Furnishment and update six world mod configurations
Install one global 1.7.0 JAR and remove the global Wheat JAR plus three obsolete local Blackridge packs
advantages: One mod name in the list
Old placed item/block IDs and asset paths remain valid
Other dependent saves are migrated before global Wheat removal
disadvantages: Manifest plugin identity changes and requires config migration
Headless smoke test cannot establish client rendering
A QUICHE native crash occurred after server startup
test_results: Byte-for-byte comparison covers all 80 old Blackridge resources and seven Tall Wheat resources
The 1.6.1 QA pack's 188 non-class resources are byte-identical in 1.7.0
Hytale 0.7.2 loaded and enabled the new pack and reached Universe ready in an isolated save
Post-install checks confirm one global JAR, old packages absent, six migrated configs and no stale lock files

transferability: Byte-level asset coverage and config-key migration are reusable; Hytale 0.7.2 pack loading was checked here. Existing placed-block rendering still needs a client check.
